assumptions: One retained Cloud encoder slot, two encoding kinds, three asynchronous loads and two callers.
Each caller retains its own load promise. Replacing the cached encoding does not replace an existing caller's result; failure clears only the matching cache entry.

Timer cancellation and callbacks follow a single JavaScript event loop. Rank-module contents, exact BPE output and idle-release behavior are checked by the real implementation conformance hook. The hook also checks the real API-server import graph.

The OpenAI per-encoding persistent cache is regression-tested by the hook but is not represented by the one-slot model. No GC reclamation deadline, network/scheduler fairness or TypeScript refinement is proved.
bounds.progress: Safety only; no scheduler or provider liveness claim.
